sentences.en: Now, just before serving and while the mixture is still foaming, add the baked apples.

sentences.en: He tried to visualize her morphing into a wolf, writhing in pain as she transformed, foaming at the mouth, snarling.

sentences.en: Most shampoos contain the same basic ingredients consisting of a detergent, a binder, a foaming agent, preservatives, and some sort of emollient to prevent cuticle stripping.

sentences.en: First there are a number of little foaming torrents, bursting through rocks about twenty yards above the promontory on which I stood.

sentences.en: How will all those rabid foaming at the mouth right wing zealots suddenly be able to be pro Euro tho?
